To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BigHealth pilot — volume & packaging questions

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for yesterday's call. We're putting together the internal case for a Q3 pilot with Redwood and want to confirm one thing before we proceed to procurement: BigHealth expects to pre-purchase a large token bucket (estimate attached) and will require a mixed deployment (hosted + private VPC for PHI workflows).

Two specific asks from our team:
- Can Redwood provide a wholesale bucket price for committed spend (12-month prepay)?
- Is there an onboarding credit or waived set-up fee for enterprise pilots of this size?

I've attached the RFP and a rough expected consumption profile. Can you send a proposal (tiering + any exceptions) by EOD tomorrow? Procurement will need an explicit credit line and an estimate of net ARR to move this forward.

Appreciate it —
Carolyn

Carolyn —

Thanks for the RFP. Quick read-through attached is a proposed tier + preliminary economics. High level: we can offer a committed 12-month bucket with stepped pricing by token bands and provide a one-time onboarding credit tied to a signed SOW.

Snapshot:
- Committed bucket: $750k prepay (12 months)
- Proposed concession: 22–25% off list on committed bucket depending on seat mix and telemetry commitment
- Onboarding credit: $40k one-time credit against first invoice (can be applied to integration or Professional Services)

I'll need internal signoff on the concession level since this is outside standard guardrails. I'm looping in my leadership to expedite. Attached: BH_Proposed_Tiers.xlsx and ROI_calculation.xlsx.

Next steps: if that range looks OK to you, can you confirm expected billing jurisdiction and whether a PO will be raised? Procurement wants a cap on any additional credits.

Best,

Subject: Fwd: BigHealth pilot — wholesale bucket concession request (need VP/CFO signoff)

Team — forwarding Carolyn's note and my proposed economics. TL;DR: BigHealth is prepared to prepay ~ $750k for a 12-month committed bucket; they require a mixed hosted + private deployment and are asking for one-off onboarding credits.

Why this is exceptional:
- Large prepay but non-standard deployment (private VPC for PHI) increases onboarding cost and ops effort.
- Strategic pilot channel: BigHealth is a top-20 prospect in hospital systems; success here will unlock other regional accounts.
- Procurement wants explicit credit cap and an approved discount to move legal/PO.

My recommendation (ask for signoff):
- Approve up to 25% concession on committed bucket, target 22% as final (net effect depends on seat mix).
- Approve one-time onboarding credit up to $40,000 applied to first invoice or PS line item.
- Condition: 12-month minimum commitment with DocuSign SOW and payment terms Net 30 on invoice schedule.

Attachments include the proposed tiering and ROI model. If we get VP/CFO signoff today we can send a revised SOW to procurement by EOD and ask legal to prepare a limited amendment for the private deployment clause.

Quick ask: Marcus — can you confirm whether $40k onboarding + 22% discount is within discretionary finance authority, or do we need explicit CFO signoff? Marissa — do you approve the recommendation from a commercial perspective?

Thanks —
Avery

[Attachments: BH_Proposed_Tiers.xlsx, ROI_calculation.xlsx]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Avery / Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. A couple of quick clarifying asks before I sign off:
1) ARR impact: the $750k prepay looks like $750k ARR if recognized over 12 months. Confirm that expected net ARR (after discount) remains >= $560k to meet revenue targets for this segment.
2) Usage surge protection: confirm whether we will add a capped overage rate (we should avoid open-ended credits).
3) Onboarding credit: I can approve up to $40k, but only if Legal signs the addendum limiting Redwood's recurring obligations and if procurement agrees to a non-refundable prepay schedule.

If those three conditions are satisfied and we get a simple cap on overages (e.g., overages billed at 60% of list beyond committed bucket), I am willing to approve the 22% concession with $40k onboarding credit. Anything above $40k or above 25% discount requires CFO clearance.

Please update the draft SOW with the cap and the payment schedule and re-circulate. Priya, can you confirm legal is OK with the limited addendum and mark any redlines you expect?

- Marcus
